message.content:
Based on the two images provided, here is an exhaustive comparison of the **OLD (Image 1)** and **NEW (Image 2)** versions of the BINUS parking app's HOME screen.

### 1. Overall Page Layout & Card Order (Top to Bottom)

The fundamental structure of the page has been significantly reorganized, moving from a dense, dark-themed dashboard to a cleaner, light-themed layout with a new top-level hierarchy.

*   **Header Bar:**
    *   **OLD:** Standard app bar with Logo/Title ("Parkir Binus"), Balance (Rp230.000), History icon, and ID button. Dark background.
    *   **NEW:** Same core elements, but adds a **Notification Bell icon** (with a red badge showing "1") and a **Theme Toggle icon** (sun/moon). The background is now white/light gray.
*   **User Greeting & Location Selector (NEW):**
    *   **OLD:** **MISSING.** The user's name and location were not displayed as a prominent header card.
    *   **NEW:** A new section appears immediately below the header. It displays the user's name (**"Rizky"** with a wave emoji) and a large, expandable location selector pill (**"BINUS @ Kemanggisan - The An..."** with "AKTIF" status).
*   **"Current Availability" Dashboard Card (NEW):**
    *   **OLD:** **MISSING.** There was no summary card for real-time occupancy at the very top.
    *   **NEW:** A new prominent card titled **"KETERSEDIAAN SEKARANG"** (Current Availability) is inserted. It features:
        *   Large orange text for available slots (**29**).
        *   Subtext (**/32 slot kosong**).
        *   A circular progress/ring chart on the right showing **3%** occupancy.
        *   A status label (**Kepadaatan**) with a colored dot.
        *   A density indicator (**Sepi · 3%**) in green text.
*   **"Check Availability For" Card:**
    *   **OLD:** This was the **first** major content card. It contained date/time pickers for "TANGGAL", "MULAI", and "SELESAI".
    *   **NEW:** This card is now **pushed down** to the second position (below the new availability dashboard). The structure remains similar but uses a lighter color scheme.
*   **"Search Slot" Button:**
    *   **OLD:** Yellow button reading "**Cari Slot**" with a chip for "**29 slot kosong**".
    *   **NEW:** Visually identical in function and position relative to the card above it, but rendered in the new light-mode style.
*   **Availability Result Summary:**
    *   **OLD:** Text block "**HASIL KETERSEDIAAN**" followed by the number "**29**", details, and a "**Peta lengkap**" (Full map) button aligned to the right.
    *   **NEW:** Present in the same position, but the "**Peta lengkap**" button styling has changed (now a light yellow/gold pill instead of a dark outline).
*   **Compact Parking Map:**
    *   Positioned below the result summary in both versions. See Section 2 for detailed changes.
*   **Map Legend:**
    *   **OLD:** Located **below** the map card. Shows dots for *Kosong* (Green), *Terbooking* (Yellow), *Tersisi* (Red), *Perawatan* (Gray). Includes helper text "Ketuk slot hijau untuk booking".
    *   **NEW:** **MISSING from view.** The legend area is either cut off or removed from this specific viewport in the new design.
*   **Promo Section:**
    *   **OLD:** Visible at the bottom. Title "**Promo kampus**" with a carousel indicator. Shows a promo card for "Kopi Rp15.000" (Fusion Cafe) with a "**Claim**" button.
    *   **NEW:** **MISSING/CUT OFF.** Not visible in the screenshot, likely pushed further down by the new header elements or removed.
*   **Heatmap Section:**
    *   **OLD:** Visible at the bottom. Title "**Heatmap permintaan**" with a small calendar heatmap grid and a floating QR code button.
    *   **NEW:** **MISSING/CUT OFF.** Not visible in the screenshot.
*   **Bottom Navigation Bar:**
    *   **OLD:** Contains icons for **Peta (Map)**, **Riwayat**, **Scan QR**, **Dompet**, **Profil**. A compass "N" indicator is on the far left.
    *   **NEW:** The order is slightly different or restyled. It shows **Location Pin** (active/highlighted), **Riwayat**, **Scan QR** (now a large central floating action button style), **Dompet**, **Profil**. The "N" compass remains.

### 2. The Compact Map Area (Detailed Comparison)

While the map depicts the same parking floor (**LANTAI 1 – GEDUNG PARKIR ANGGREK**), the visual rendering of the slots differs.

*   **Map Header Strip:**
    *   **Text:** Identical in both ("LANTAI 1...", "29/32 slot").
    *   **Styling:**
        *   **OLD:** White text on dark gray background. The "29/32 slot" chip is a solid teal/cyan color.
        *   **NEW:** Dark gray text on light gray background. The "29/32 slot" chip is outlined or lighter teal.
*   **Slot Rows & Layout:**
    *   **Structure:** Both show **2 rows** of slots (Row A, Row B) separated by a dashed line representing the drive lane.
    *   **Visible Slots:**
        *   **Row A:** Shows slots **A-01 through A-06** (and partial A-07).
        *   **Row B:** Shows slots **B-01 through B-06** (and partial B-07).
    *   **Slot Status Indicators:**
        *   **A-03:** Red/Pink in both (indicating occupied/taken).
        *   **Others (A-01, A-02, A-04... B-06):** Green circles indicating empty.
        *   **Visual Change:** In the **OLD** version, the green circles have a distinct **darker green dot in the center**. In the **NEW** version, the green circles appear more solid or have a different internal highlight pattern (looks like a small sparkle or just flatter color).
*   **Pillars / Obstructions:**
    *   No structural pillars are drawn between slots in either version; it is a clean grid.
*   **Floating Elements on Map:**
    *   **OLD:** Clean map surface.
    *   **NEW:** There is a **large, yellow circular Floating Action Button (FAB)** with a **QR code icon** overlaid on the bottom center of the map/card area. This likely serves as a shortcut to scan a QR code.

### 3. Missing or Repositioned Elements

| Element | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Notification Bell** | **Added (New)** | Top right header, red badge "1". |
| **Theme Toggle** | **Added (New)** | Top right header (sun icon). |
| **User Greeting ("Rizky")** | **Added (New)** | New section below header. |
| **Location Selector Pill** | **Added (New)** | Large pill below greeting, replaces implicit location. |
| **"Availability Now" Card** | **Added (New)** | New dashboard card with big "29" and 3% ring. |
| **Map Legend** | **Missing (New)** | The row of colored dots (Kosong, Terbooking, etc.) below the map is gone. |
| **Promo Section** | **Missing (New)** | "Promo kampus" section not visible. |
| **Heatmap Section** | **Missing (New)** | "Heatmap permintaan" not visible. |
| **QR Scan FAB** | **Repositioned (New)** | Moved from bottom nav (small icon) to a large overlay button on the map area. |
| **Bottom Nav "Map" Icon** | **Changed** | Replaced/merged with Location Pin icon which is now "Active". |

### 4. Verdict: What Changed?

The update represents a **major UI/UX modernization and restructuring**, shifting from a **Dark Mode utility view** to a **Light Mode informational dashboard**.

1.  **Visual Theme:** Complete switch from **Dark Mode (Black/Dark Gray background)** to **Light Mode (White/Light Gray background)**.
2.  **Information Hierarchy:** The app now prioritizes **real-time status**. The "Current Availability" (with the percentage ring) and User Context (Name/Location) are promoted to the top, pushing the "Search/Booking" tools down.
3.  **Navigation UX:** The introduction of a **floating QR scanner button** over the content suggests a shift towards making the "Scan to Park" action more accessible (thumb-friendly), while the bottom nav was simplified.
4.  **Content Density:** The new layout is "taller"—users must scroll further down to see Promos and Heatmaps, which were previously visible "above the fold" or near the bottom of the old screen. The Legend was removed to save space.
